title: search_backed_list_resources allowlist gates STORE LIST via search
answers: How do I opt a resource into the search-backed LIST path?
Where is the unified_storage search-list allowlist configured?
What controls which group/resource LIST requests use the search index vs the SQL store?
body: The [unified_storage] ini section's search_backed_list_resources key (comma-separated group/resource pairs) is parsed in pkg/setting/setting_unified_storage.go:setUnifiedStorageConfig into Cfg.SearchBackedListResources, then wired by pkg/storage/unified/sql/server.go:withSearchBackedListConfig into resource.ResourceServerOptions.SearchBackedListConfig, and consulted at runtime via server.searchBackedListResources.Allowed(group, resource) in shouldUseSearchForList. The list is empty by default, so routing stays opt-in until a resource is explicitly added.
applies: unified storage server configuration for LIST routing
says: How do I enable search-based listing for a resource type?

Configuring search-backed list in unified storage settings

Resource list requests not routing through search index
search: Configuration key [unified_storage] search_backed_list_resources (comma-separated group/resource pairs) controls which resources route LIST through search index in unified storage. Parsed by pkg/setting/setting_unified_storage.go:setUnifiedStorageConfig into Cfg.SearchBackedListResources, wired by pkg/storage/unified/sql/server.go:withSearchBackedListConfig into ResourceServerOptions.SearchBackedListConfig, and checked at runtime via server.searchBackedListResources.Allowed(group, resource) in shouldUseSearchForList. Empty by default; routing remains opt-in until explicitly enabled per resource.
